# Setup source repo
mkdir source/skill_a
mkdir source/skill_b

-- source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
---
name: skill_a
description: Skill A from Source
---
# Source Repo File

-- source/skill_b/SKILL.md --
---
name: skill_b
description: Skill B from Source
---
# Skill B from Source

-- source/axen.json --
{
  "axen_version": "1",
  "name": "source",
  "skills": {
    "skill_a": { "path": "skill_a" },
    "skill_b": { "path": "skill_b" }
  }
}

# 1. Setup pre-existing untracked file
-- .claude/skills/skill_a/SKILL.md --
# Original Manual File

# 2. Test conflict-strategy=keep preserves manual file
exec axen source add ./source -n source
exec axen install source --skills=skill_a --targets=claude --conflict-strategy=keep
grep '# Original Manual File' .claude/skills/skill_a/SKILL.md

# 3. Test conflict-strategy=overwrite replaces manual file
exec axen install source --skills=skill_a --targets=claude --conflict-strategy=overwrite
grep '# Source Repo File' .claude/skills/skill_a/SKILL.md

# 4. Test --dry-run does not write new skill files to disk
exec axen install source --skills=skill_b --targets=claude --dry-run
! exists .claude/skills/skill_b/SKILL.md
